items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you mention someone’s name? You said someone named Lynn or somebody? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No. A service.

ctx.x: Well back then you had a service. So you’d sign up and you’d pay a nominal fee. And a lady would call you up and say well I have a date for you at Paramount or whatever the studio was, Evergreen, or whichever studio. And they would say downbeat is 9 a.m. and it’s a jingle for Burger King or some product or whatever or some beer commercial. And they’d say it’s a 3-hour call or it’s a 6-hour call.
Did you mention someone’s name? You said someone named Lynn or somebody? Oh I thought you said someone’s name.
